load_testing_tools.name: Grafana k6 Documentation

load_testing_tools.name: k6 Rate metric
load_testing_tools.description: Rate metric semantics: the percentage of added values that are non-zero, computed over every add() call, not just failing ones. A script that only calls errorRate.add(1) on failure (and never adds on success) reports a misleadingly high rate. Verified locally with k6 2.3.0: a 10-iteration script with 1 real failure read 100% under the add(1)-on-failure-only pattern and the correct 10% under add(!ok) on every request.

load_testing_tools.name: Gatling Injection Profiles
load_testing_tools.description: Gatling injection-profile reference: atOnceUsers/rampUsers/constantUsersPerSec/rampUsersPerSec are open-loop (arrival-rate) profiles; constantConcurrentUsers/rampConcurrentUsers are closed-loop (fixed-concurrency) profiles. Gatling is not closed-loop by default — the profile chosen determines the model.
